summary: Show Popup: overlays a component on top of the app when triggered; the popup closes itself and can hand back results.
description: Show Popup instantiates `target` (a component) as an overlay above everything else when `show` fires. The popup component owns its dismissal: a Close Popup node inside it removes the overlay, fires this node's `Closed` signal, and delivers any declared result values as outputs here — plus one signal output per close action, so 'confirmed' and 'dismissed' can be told apart at the call site. `Closed` is a *later* event about a popup that opened — `done` is the one that says the `show` itself finished, and it fires the moment the popup is on screen.
whenToUse: Dialogs, sheets, confirmations — transient UI that must sit above the page and return an answer. For a persistent section of the page, conditional `mounted` on a Group is lighter; for full pages use Router or Component Stack.

ports.target: The component shown as the overlay.
ports.Closed: Signal; fires when the popup closed, after result outputs update.

runtimeBehavior: Result-value outputs and per-close-action signals are generated from the Close Popup configuration inside the target component; the target's Component Inputs also surface as inputs here. All of it is project-content-determined.
patterns: Confirmation dialog: show → popup's confirm/cancel close actions → distinct signals at the caller.
antiPatterns: Closing a popup from outside it — dismissal belongs inside the popup component, where Close Popup works.
